## WHY WE THINK WE'RE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We take work-life balance seriously. The level of focus observed among employees is incredibly high with incentives to move fast, remediate problems, and meet deadlines. Our culture of peer accountability means putting each other in position to rise to the occasion. You should enjoy coming to work but make time to smell the roses. We have birthdays, happy hours, impromptu Super Smash Bros. games, gossiping about our favorite trainers at Barry's Bootcamp, and dogs snuggling up to your feet. Employees can be themselves. We celebrate people for who they are. Celebrating our differences prevents us from becoming a Dilbert office.
